records.source: Counting by eye usually records only a total: there is no record of where each object was counted, no way to recount, and no way to compare two scorers beyond the total.
records.translation: El recuento a ojo suele registrar solo un total: no queda constancia de dónde se contó cada objeto, no hay forma de volver a contar ni de comparar a dos evaluadores más allá del total.

records.context: This module records manual counts on a :class:`spacr.layers.PointsLayer`, so each click is stored as data. Every marker is a world coordinate on a layer that can be hidden, recoloured, saved and reopened; the tally is derived from the markers rather than typed; and the export is one row per click, so two scorers can be compared point by point and a disputed count can be inspected.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context

Every marker is a world coordinate on a layer that can be hidden, recoloured, saved and reopened; the tally is derived from the markers rather than typed; and the export is one row per click, so two scorers can be compared point by point and a disputed count can be inspected.
records.translation: Este módulo registra los recuentos manuales en un :class:`spacr.layers.PointsLayer`, de modo que cada clic se almacena como datos. Cada marcador es una coordenada del mundo en una capa que puede ocultarse, recolorearse, guardarse y volver a abrirse; el recuento se deriva de los marcadores en lugar de escribirse a mano; y la exportación tiene una fila por clic, de modo que dos evaluadores pueden compararse punto por punto y un recuento discutido puede inspeccionarse.

records.source: One layer per class
records.translation: Una capa por clase

records.context: A class is a whole :class:`~spacr.layers.PointsLayer`, not a property column on a shared one. That is what buys per-class colour and per-class visibility from the existing model — "hide the uninfected markers and count again" is a checkbox in the layer list, not a feature — and it is why the class colours here are the layer's own ``face_color``. The undo history that crosses classes lives in the session, which is the one thing a per-layer view cannot own.

records.source: A class is a whole :class:`~spacr.layers.PointsLayer`, not a property column on a shared one. That is what buys per-class colour and per-class visibility from the existing model — "hide the uninfected markers and count again" is a checkbox in the layer list, not a feature — and it is why the class colours here are the layer's own ``face_color``. The undo history that crosses classes lives in the session, which is the one thing a per-layer view cannot own.
records.translation: Una clase es un :class:`~spacr.layers.PointsLayer` completo, no una columna de propiedades en una capa compartida. Eso es lo que proporciona color y visibilidad por clase a partir del modelo existente ("hide the uninfected markers and count again" es una casilla en la lista de capas, no una funcionalidad), y es el motivo de que los colores de clase sean aquí el propio ``face_color`` de la capa. El historial de deshacer que abarca varias clases reside en la sesión, que es lo único que una vista por capa no puede poseer.

records.context: This is the gene-level counterpart of the guide-level permutation test. The gene's regressor is the sum of its guides' fractions -- one column, one test, one degree of freedom -- residualized against the same block/nuisance design and permuted with the same Freedman--Lane scheme. Passing the same ``random_state`` as the guide pass makes the permutations identical, because the permuted object is the residual of the same outcome against the same nuisance design.
records.label: spacr.guide_permutation.gene_freedman_lane_test#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: This is the gene-level counterpart of the guide-level permutation test. The gene's regressor is the sum of its guides' fractions -- one column, one test, one degree of freedom -- residualized against the same block/nuisance design and permuted with the same Freedman--Lane scheme. Passing the same ``random_state`` as the guide pass makes the permutations identical, because the permuted object is the residual of the same outcome against the same nuisance design.
records.translation: Es la contrapartida a nivel de gen de la prueba de permutación a nivel de guía. El regresor del gen es la suma de las fracciones de sus guías (una columna, una prueba, un grado de libertad), residualizado frente al mismo diseño de bloques y de confusión y permutado con el mismo esquema de Freedman--Lane. Pasar el mismo ``random_state`` que en la pasada por guías hace que las permutaciones sean idénticas, porque el objeto permutado es el residuo del mismo resultado frente al mismo diseño de confusión.

records.context: The test does not combine per-guide P values. Fisher's and Stouffer's methods both assume the p-values being combined are independent, and two guides measured in the same microplate sample positions are not: they share the microplate sample position's phenotype, the microplate sample position's laboratory microplate effect and the microplate sample position's cells. Combining them would report a confidence the design cannot support.
records.label: spacr.guide_permutation.gene_freedman_lane_test#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The test does not combine per-guide P values. Fisher's and Stouffer's methods both assume the p-values being combined are independent, and two guides measured in the same wells are not: they share the well's phenotype, the well's plate effect and the well's cells. Combining them would report a confidence the design cannot support.
records.translation: La prueba no combina los valores P por guía. Los métodos de Fisher y de Stouffer suponen ambos que los valores p que se combinan son independientes, y dos guías medidas en los mismos pocillos no lo son: comparten el fenotipo del pocillo, el efecto de placa del pocillo y las células del pocillo. Combinarlos notificaría una confianza que el diseño no puede respaldar.

records.context: A one-degree-of-freedom set test cannot detect guides with opposite effects, which is why ``guides_in_gene`` is reported on every row: a gene whose guides push the phenotype in opposite directions cancels in the sum, exactly as it does in the parametric ``y ~ gene_fraction:gene`` fit that this mirrors. Such a gene is not evidence of no effect; it is evidence the guides disagree, and the guide-level table is where that shows. A gene resting on one guide (``guides_in_gene == 1``) is the same test as that guide's own row.
records.label: spacr.guide_permutation.gene_freedman_lane_test#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context

Such a gene is not evidence of no effect; it is evidence the guides disagree, and the guide-level table is where that shows. A gene resting on one guide (``guides_in_gene == 1``) is the same test as that guide's own row.
records.translation: Una prueba de conjunto con un grado de libertad no puede detectar guías con efectos opuestos, por lo que ``guides_in_gene`` se notifica en cada fila: un gen cuyas guías empujan el fenotipo en direcciones opuestas se anula en la suma, exactamente igual que en el ajuste paramétrico ``y ~ gene_fraction:gene`` que esto reproduce. Un gen así no es prueba de ausencia de efecto; es prueba de que las guías discrepan, y la tabla a nivel de guía es donde eso se ve. Un gen que depende de una sola guía (``guides_in_gene == 1``) es la misma prueba que la fila propia de esa guía.

records.context: The ``+1`` in both places includes the observed configuration in its own reference set, which makes the test exact, giving ``P(p <= alpha) <= alpha`` under the null for any ``B``. It also sets a floor of ``1 / (B + 1)`` -- with the default 200,000 permutations, 5e-06. A guide at the floor is one no permutation reached, and guides there cannot be ranked against each other; raising ``B`` is the only remedy and costs linearly. The ``eps`` keeps a permutation that reproduces the observed statistic exactly from failing its own ``>=``.
records.label: spacr.guide_permutation.guide_freedman_lane_test#11
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The ``+1`` in both places includes the observed configuration in its own reference set, which makes the test exact, giving ``P(p <= alpha) <= alpha`` under the null for any ``B``. It also sets a floor of ``1 / (B + 1)`` -- with the default 200,000 permutations, 5e-06. A guide at the floor is one no permutation reached, and guides there cannot be ranked against each other; raising ``B`` is the only remedy and costs linearly. The ``eps`` keeps a permutation that reproduces the observed statistic exactly from failing its own ``>=``.
records.translation: El ``+1`` en ambos lugares incluye la configuración observada en su propio conjunto de referencia, lo que hace exacta la prueba y da ``P(p <= alpha) <= alpha`` bajo la hipótesis nula para cualquier ``B``. También fija un mínimo de ``1 / (B + 1)``: con las 200,000 permutaciones por defecto, 5e-06. Una guía en ese mínimo es una que ninguna permutación alcanzó, y las guías que están ahí no pueden clasificarse entre sí; aumentar ``B`` es el único remedio y su coste es lineal. El ``eps`` evita que una permutación que reproduce exactamente el estadístico observado no supere su propio ``>=``.

records.context: Permutations run in batches of ``batch_size`` so an ``n x batch_size`` block is materialised instead of ``n x B``. Exceedances accumulate across batches; the result is identical and the memory is bounded.
records.label: spacr.guide_permutation.guide_freedman_lane_test#12
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Permutations run in batches of ``batch_size`` so an ``n x batch_size`` block is materialised instead of ``n x B``. Exceedances accumulate across batches; the result is identical and the memory is bounded.
records.translation: Las permutaciones se ejecutan en lotes de ``batch_size``, de modo que se materializa un bloque ``n x batch_size`` en lugar de ``n x B``. Las superaciones se acumulan entre lotes; el resultado es idéntico y la memoria está acotada.

records.context: **What it assumes.** Exchangeability of ``y~`` within a block under the null. Structure inside a plate that ``Z`` does not capture -- an edge effect ``rowID``/``columnID`` misses, a batch within a plate -- breaks it, and the P values are then anti-conservative.
records.label: spacr.guide_permutation.guide_freedman_lane_test#13
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **What it assumes.** Exchangeability of ``y~`` within a block under the null. Structure inside a plate that ``Z`` does not capture -- an edge effect ``rowID``/``columnID`` misses, a batch within a plate -- breaks it, and the P values are then anti-conservative.
records.translation: **Lo que supone.** La intercambiabilidad de ``y~`` dentro de un bloque bajo la hipótesis nula. Una estructura dentro de una placa que ``Z`` no capture (un efecto de borde que se le escape a ``rowID``/``columnID``, un lote dentro de una placa) la rompe, y entonces los valores P son anticonservadores.

records.context: **What it does not give.** A conditional coefficient. Each guide is tested alone, so two guides in one microplate sample position both take credit and the test cannot apportion the effect between them. That is the price of having no rank requirement: guides may outnumber microplate sample positions here, and may not in a model that fits them all at once.
records.label: spacr.guide_permutation.guide_freedman_lane_test#14
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **What it does not give.** A conditional coefficient. Each guide is tested alone, so two guides in one well both take credit and the test cannot apportion the effect between them. That is the price of having no rank requirement: guides may outnumber wells here, and may not in a model that fits them all at once.
records.translation: **Lo que no proporciona.** Un coeficiente condicional. Cada guía se prueba por separado, de modo que dos guías de un mismo pocillo se atribuyen ambas el mérito y la prueba no puede repartir el efecto entre ellas. Es el precio de no exigir rango completo: aquí las guías pueden superar en número a los pocillos, algo que no es posible en un modelo que las ajuste todas a la vez.

records.context: Permutation P values are computed once for every guide satisfying the smallest requested support threshold.  For each displayed threshold, the eligible subset is then corrected as its own multiple-testing family. This keeps the observed statistic and empirical P value for a guide identical across thresholds; only the adjusted value changes with family size.
records.label: spacr.guide_permutation.guide_freedman_lane_test#15
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Permutation P values are computed once for every guide satisfying the smallest requested support threshold.  For each displayed threshold, the eligible subset is then corrected as its own multiple-testing family. This keeps the observed statistic and empirical P value for a guide identical across thresholds; only the adjusted value changes with family size.
records.translation: Los valores P de permutación se calculan una vez para cada guía que cumple el menor umbral de soporte solicitado. Para cada umbral mostrado, el subconjunto elegible se corrige después como su propia familia de pruebas múltiples. records.context: Three things this does that a naive shuffle does not. The nuisance fit is added back before re-projecting, so the reference distribution is "no guide effect given Z" rather than "no structure at all". The denominator is recomputed per permutation, because ``M P_b y~`` does not preserve norm and a fixed one would let the null drift with the shuffle. And the shuffle is confined to a block, because permuting across plates would let a plate effect leak into the null and inflate significance.
records.label: spacr.guide_permutation.guide_freedman_lane_test#9
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three things this does that a naive shuffle does not. The nuisance fit is added back before re-projecting, so the reference distribution is "no guide effect given Z" rather than "no structure at all". The denominator is recomputed per permutation, because ``M P_b y~`` does not preserve norm and a fixed one would let the null drift with the shuffle. And the shuffle is confined to a block, because permuting across plates would let a plate effect leak into the null and inflate significance.
records.translation: Tres cosas que esto hace y que un barajado ingenuo no hace. El ajuste de confusión se vuelve a sumar antes de proyectar de nuevo, de modo que la distribución de referencia es "no guide effect given Z" y no "no structure at all". El denominador se recalcula en cada permutación, porque ``M P_b y~`` no conserva la norma y uno fijo dejaría que la distribución nula derivara con el barajado. Y el barajado se limita a un bloque, porque permutar entre placas dejaría que un efecto de placa se filtrara a la distribución nula e inflara la significación.

records.source: Every resource figure in the package counts the calling process: `spacr.fit_resources.host_rss` reads ``/proc/self/statm``, `spacr.qt.timing` reads its own resident size, and the parameter sweep's floor reads the machine's free memory, which cannot tell spaCR's own children from another tenant on a shared box.

records.context: spaCR's heaviest work does not happen in the calling process -- `spacr.sequencing` starts a saver process and `spacr.parameter_sweep` runs every trial in a child -- so the parent's own memory stays low until the out-of-memory killer ends the processing session, and afterwards there is nothing to read.
records.label: spacr.resource_log#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: spaCR's heaviest work does not happen in the calling process -- `spacr.sequencing` starts a saver process and `spacr.parameter_sweep` runs every trial in a child -- so the parent's own memory stays low until the out-of-memory killer ends the run, and afterwards there is nothing to read.
records.translation: El trabajo más pesado de spaCR no ocurre en el proceso que llama (`spacr.sequencing` inicia un proceso de guardado y `spacr.parameter_sweep` ejecuta cada ensayo en un proceso hijo), de modo que la memoria propia del proceso padre sigue siendo baja hasta que el mecanismo de terminación por falta de memoria pone fin a la ejecución, y después no queda nada que leer.

records.context: Why this is not part of verbose logging: verbose logging only decides which log records are kept, so it records no memory figures. The function tracer that it once installed fired on every call and every return, and it made startup twenty times slower; a measurement taken under a tracer describes the traced program rather than the normal one. This module samples instead: one psutil read a second, on a daemon independent execution path that is never the main GUI execution path, on an otherwise unmodified run. There are three levels rather than an on/off checkbox, and the default (:data:`DEFAULT_LEVEL`, ``"summary"``) is not ``"off"``, because resource data is most useful from runs that were not expected to fail.
records.label: spacr.resource_log#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Why this is not part of verbose logging: verbose logging only decides which log records are kept, so it records no memory figures. The function tracer that it once installed fired on every call and every return, and it made startup twenty times slower; a measurement taken under a tracer describes the traced program rather than the normal one. This module samples instead: one psutil read a second, on a daemon thread that is never the GUI thread, on an otherwise unmodified run. There are three levels rather than an on/off checkbox, and the default (:data:`DEFAULT_LEVEL`, ``"summary"``) is not ``"off"``, because resource data is most useful from runs that were not expected to fail.
records.translation: Por qué esto no forma parte del registro detallado: el registro detallado solo decide qué entradas de registro se conservan, de modo que no registra ninguna cifra de memoria. El trazador de funciones que llegó a instalar se activaba en cada llamada y en cada retorno, y hacía el inicio veinte veces más lento; una medición tomada bajo un trazador describe el programa trazado y no el normal. En su lugar, este módulo toma muestras: una lectura de psutil por segundo, en un hilo demonio que nunca es el hilo de la GUI, sobre una ejecución por lo demás sin modificar. Hay tres niveles en lugar de una casilla de activación, y el valor por defecto (:data:`DEFAULT_LEVEL`, ``"summary"``) no es ``"off"``, porque los datos de recursos son más útiles en las ejecuciones de las que no se esperaba que fallaran.

records.context: Which memory figure is recorded: USS where the platform gives it, then PSS, then RSS -- and every record names the measure it used, because RSS double-counts the pages a fork shares and would overstate a sweep badly. A number whose definition is unrecorded cannot be compared between two machines.
records.label: spacr.resource_log#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Which memory figure is recorded: USS where the platform gives it, then PSS, then RSS -- and every record names the measure it used, because RSS double-counts the pages a fork shares and would overstate a sweep badly. A number whose definition is unrecorded cannot be compared between two machines.
records.translation: Qué cifra de memoria se registra: USS cuando la plataforma la proporciona, después PSS y después RSS, y cada registro nombra la medida que usó, porque RSS cuenta dos veces las páginas que comparte un fork y sobrestimaría mucho un barrido. Un número cuya definición no se ha registrado no puede compararse entre dos máquinas.

records.context: No single reading is required to succeed. A child that exits between being enumerated and being read is an expected outcome and not an error: that child is skipped, the rest of the tree is kept, and the count of skipped readings goes in the sample so the record says what it missed. A platform that cannot supply a per-independent execution path time records that it could not, never a zero, because a zero reads as "this thread was free". Per-independent execution path GPU memory is absent on purpose: a CUDA context belongs to a process, so a per-independent execution path figure would have no meaning.
records.label: spacr.resource_log#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: No single reading is required to succeed. A child that exits between being enumerated and being read is an expected outcome and not an error: that child is skipped, the rest of the tree is kept, and the count of skipped readings goes in the sample so the record says what it missed. A platform that cannot supply a per-thread time records that it could not, never a zero, because a zero reads as "this thread was free". Per-thread GPU memory is absent on purpose: a CUDA context belongs to a process, so a per-thread figure would have no meaning.
records.translation: No es necesario que ninguna lectura individual tenga éxito. Un proceso hijo que termina entre su enumeración y su lectura es un resultado esperado y no un error: ese proceso se omite, se conserva el resto del árbol y el número de lecturas omitidas se incluye en la muestra para que el registro indique lo que se perdió. Una plataforma que no puede proporcionar un tiempo por hilo registra que no pudo, nunca un cero, porque un cero se interpreta como "this thread was free". La memoria GPU por hilo se omite a propósito: un contexto CUDA pertenece a un proceso, de modo que una cifra por hilo no tendría ningún significado.

records.source: A daemon thread takes one reading every effective ``interval`` seconds into a ring buffer of ``capacity`` samples. The default settings retain the most recent hour in memory; custom settings retain approximately ``capacity * interval`` seconds. A run that lasts a week therefore cannot grow the in-memory series without limit.
records.translation: Un hilo demonio toma una lectura cada ``interval`` segundos efectivos en un búfer circular de ``capacity`` muestras. Los ajustes por defecto conservan en memoria la última hora; los ajustes personalizados conservan aproximadamente ``capacity * interval`` segundos. Por tanto, una ejecución que dure una semana no puede hacer crecer sin límite la serie en memoria.

records.context: The advisor separates measured choices, settings that remain undecided, and questions the data cannot answer. Each proposed value includes its reason, and this module never writes settings itself.
records.label: spacr.settings_advisor#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The advisor separates measured choices, settings that remain undecided, and questions the data cannot answer. Each proposed value includes its reason, and this module never writes settings itself.
records.translation: El asesor separa las elecciones medidas, los ajustes que siguen sin decidir y las preguntas que los datos no pueden responder. Cada valor propuesto incluye su motivo, y este módulo nunca escribe ajustes por sí mismo.

records.context: Count-table summaries use every available well. Object-level score tables may be large, so response diagnostics use a capped sample and mark the resulting :class:`Reading` accordingly. Family, control, and fraction choices reuse the same analysis helpers as the regression workflow.
records.label: spacr.settings_advisor#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Count-table summaries use every available well. Object-level score tables may be large, so response diagnostics use a capped sample and mark the resulting :class:`Reading` accordingly. Family, control, and fraction choices reuse the same analysis helpers as the regression pipeline.
records.translation: Los resúmenes de las tablas de recuentos usan todos los pocillos disponibles. Las tablas de puntuaciones a nivel de objeto pueden ser grandes, por lo que los diagnósticos de la respuesta usan una muestra limitada y marcan en consecuencia el :class:`Reading` resultante. Las elecciones de familia, de controles y de fracciones reutilizan los mismos auxiliares de análisis que la cadena de procesamiento de la regresión.

records.source: Assignments can therefore borrow evidence for the same perturbation across wells while retaining an explicit abstention state. The propagated mass, competing-label evidence, and total anchor reach remain available separately so ambiguous or unsupported calls can be inspected instead of forced.
records.translation: Por tanto, las asignaciones pueden tomar evidencia de la misma perturbación en distintos pocillos conservando un estado de abstención explícito. La masa propagada, la evidencia de etiquetas competidoras y el alcance total desde los anclajes siguen disponibles por separado, de modo que las asignaciones ambiguas o sin respaldo pueden inspeccionarse en lugar de forzarse.

records.source: **spaCR writes canonical names.** ``write_table`` and ``write_database`` canonicalise on the way out by default, so a frame assembled by hand cannot re-export ``column_name`` and start the cycle again. The header of an exported file therefore changes for anyone whose downstream script reads ``column_name`` -- a documented compatibility change. ``canonicalise=False`` is there for a caller who owes an external format an exact header.
records.translation: **spaCR escribe nombres canónicos.** ``write_table`` y ``write_database`` normalizan los nombres al escribir por defecto, de modo que una tabla montada a mano no puede volver a exportar ``column_name`` y reiniciar el ciclo. Por tanto, el encabezado de un archivo exportado cambia para cualquiera cuyo script posterior lea ``column_name``, un cambio de compatibilidad documentado. ``canonicalise=False`` existe para quien debe respetar el encabezado exacto de un formato externo.

records.translation: Es inmutable y admite el ciclo de ida y vuelta, de modo que una fila guardada hoy en el disco reconstruye mañana la misma configuración solicitada. ``columns`` forma parte de ella: una receta que registrara solo los hiperparámetros solicitaría otro mapa en cuanto cambiara la selección de columnas. records.context: This is the clustering half of the ParaScape-style walk.  It can execute for every UMAP trial as that trial arrives, or later against the table row the user chose. Duplicate and out-of-range candidate sizes are skipped; if no size is meaningful the call is refused rather than fabricating a one-cluster winner. A clustering failure propagates, while an undefined silhouette is retained as ``nan`` and ranks below every measured score.
records.label: spacr.umap_search.walk_clusters#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: This is the clustering half of the ParaScape-style walk.  It can run for every UMAP trial as that trial arrives, or later against the table row the user chose. Duplicate and out-of-range candidate sizes are skipped; if no size is meaningful the call is refused rather than fabricating a one-cluster winner. A clustering failure propagates, while an undefined silhouette is retained as ``nan`` and ranks below every measured score.
records.translation: Es la mitad de agrupamiento del recorrido al estilo de ParaScape. Puede ejecutarse para cada ensayo de UMAP a medida que llega, o más tarde sobre la fila de la tabla que eligió el usuario. Los tamaños candidatos duplicados o fuera de intervalo se omiten; si ningún tamaño tiene sentido, la llamada se rechaza en lugar de fabricar un ganador de un solo grupo. Un fallo del agrupamiento se propaga, mientras que una silueta no definida se conserva como ``nan`` y queda por debajo de todas las puntuaciones medidas.
